description: khuedoan/homelab at 8b9d40f (GPL-3.0: fetched read-only into the golden cache at test time, never vendored or committed), run with exactly one alias and no declared edges (US11.2, BR11.4). The expected output is the reduced form: node ids and counts only, no other text of the repository. Nothing in the estate deploys system/argocd (whose chart renders the root ApplicationSet), so without the crank the run is NOTHING ANALYSED (exit 2) and lists the chart directories nothing deploys (lead decision for B7, FR7.4). The reduced form counts floating revisions without the note that a chart's two renders differed (three charts of this estate render varying content; docs/limits.md).

mutations.why: with one Application of crankpath's own that deploys system/argocd, the estate has an entry point: the chart renders the root ApplicationSet, which is expanded, and both research cycles appear, extracted, in one strongly connected component

# Written by crankpath's golden harness for this mutation (not repository text): an Application
# that deploys system/argocd from the in-cluster Git server, the entry point the estate lacks.
apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1
kind: Application
metadata:
  name: bootstrap
  namespace: argocd
spec:
  project: default
  source:
    repoURL: http://gitea-http.gitea:3000/ops/homelab
    targetRevision: 8b9d40f51e528bcc642ea9d052eecfc7c23b5cda
    path: system/argocd
  destination:
    server: https://kubernetes.default.svc
    namespace: argocd
